layout: format_version:u8 | flags:u8 | anchor_len:u16le | bind_fingerprint:16 | anchor:anchor_len | payload:rest

cases.name: valid_unsealed
cases.note: Keyless worker (subprocess/unix - DuckDB's primary path). Payload is plaintext.

cases.name: valid_sealed
cases.note: Keyed worker. Parse-only: the AEAD nonce is random, so bytes differ per run.

cases.name: bad_flags_unsealed_but_key_present
cases.note: THE alg:none CASE. Structurally a valid unsealed token. A worker that holds a signing key MUST refuse it - flags is attacker-controlled, so the key state decides whether to unseal, never the token.

cases.name: stale_anchor
cases.note: Anchor names a catalog version that is gone. Distinct kind from INVALID: only this one means 're-run the query'.

cases.name: reserved_flag_bit
cases.note: bits 1-7 of flags are reserved and MUST be zero.

cases.name: bad_version
cases.note: format_version is checked unconditionally, before anything else.

cases.name: anchor_len_overrun
cases.note: anchor_len claims more bytes than the token holds.
